title: Pay land tax
what: Pay land tax each year on taxable land the business owns in the state, above any tax-free threshold.

sources.title: Land Tax Assessment Act 2002 (WA)
sources.quote: Land tax is payable, in accordance with the land tax Acts, for each financial year for all land in the State except land that is exempt under section 17.

sources.title: Land Tax Assessment Act 2002 (WA)
sources.quote: The Commissioner may assess the amount of land tax payable on land on which a building containing non-strata home units is situated

triggers.note: Each year, on land owned at the date set by the law. Most owners pay only above a tax-free threshold, which differs by state and by owner (individual, company or trust); thresholds are not yet quoted.

reach.condition: if it owns land in WA that is not exempt
reach.note: Any business that owns taxable land in the state; exemptions (such as a home or primary production land) are not yet recorded.

sources.title: Land Tax Assessment Act 2002 (WA)

confidence_note: The rates are in the Land Tax Act 2002 (WA), not yet quoted.

assessment.summary: An annual tax on the value of land owned, with exemptions and a tax-free threshold. A tax on land value distorts little in principle, but thresholds, exemptions and rates that rise with total holdings narrow the base and change who holds land and how.

marks.reason: Exemptions, thresholds and rates that rise with total holdings narrow the base and tax owners unevenly, so land use and ownership respond to the tax.

assessment.confidence_note: Marked from the tax's design against the framework's guide; the size of the effect varies by state and was not measured.
